areas.name: Flooded Cistern
areas.notes: Waist-deep water in the middle; the deep pool hides the drowned abbot's ring.

areas.name: Collapsed Stair
areas.notes: Way in from the abbey ruins above. Rubble is difficult terrain.

areas.name: Hall of Pillars
areas.notes: Eight pillars carved as hooded monks. The statue's eyes follow light sources.

areas.name: Ossuary
areas.notes: Secret door from the hall (Instinct 14). Stairs descend to the cistern.
